coldCallInfo.card1Title: The fastest way to reach a client
coldCallInfo.card1Text: A phone call is the only form of contact where you get an answer within seconds — not days. While your competition waits for an email response, you already know if the client is interested. A cold call with a good script isn't cold calling — it's a precision tool that does in 3 minutes what email does in 3 weeks.
coldCallInfo.card2Text: Each script is generated individually for every company — differently for a carpenter with 2 reviews, differently for a restaurant with 200 reviews and a great rating. AI analyzes the industry, online reputation, and your conversation goal, so the script sounds like preparation, not a template. The business owner hears someone who did their homework.
coldCallInfo.stat1Label: time it takes to generate a script for one company
coldCallInfo.stat2Label: average length of an effective cold call conversation
coldCallInfo.stat3Label: a spreadsheet with names and phone numbers is all you need — AI handles the rest

smsInfo.card1Title: The largest reach of all channels
smsInfo.card1Text: 98% of people open SMS messages — only 20% open emails. A text message goes directly to the business owner's pocket, without spam filters, without social media algorithms. One SMS campaign to 100 companies takes as much time as writing one email — except it reaches a hundred times more people at once.
smsInfo.card2Text: A message to a carpenter with 3 reviews sounds different than a message to a developer with 400 reviews and a 4.9 rating. AI understands the context of each company — its industry, online reputation, web presence — and writes an SMS that looks like a personal message, not a mass mailing. The client doesn't know 99 other companies received it too.
smsInfo.mode1Text: You get ready-made messages for each company. You can review each one, edit if you want, send when you're ready. Full control over what goes out.
smsInfo.mode2Text: AI generates and immediately sends SMS from your number. Perfect when you have a large list and want to save time. Each message reaches the business owner without your involvement.

coldEmailInfo.card1Text: Email gives you something SMS and phone calls don't — space. You can show that you understand the client's business, reference their situation, present concrete value, and give them time to think. The business owner can return to the email when ready — and often does, if the message was written thoughtfully.
coldEmailInfo.card2Text: Each email is generated after deep analysis of the company — its industry, number and quality of Google reviews, web presence, and your offer's goal. If a company already has a website, AI doesn't suggest building one — it finds another angle. If a company has weak online visibility, the email mentions it with specific numbers, not generalities.
